conviction_note: Near-zero. Nitto has raised its forecast at every print since 2025-07, and the street already sits about 2% above the plan (FY EPS consensus 219.8 against 215.75), so the likely H1 beat and modest raise look priced. The stock has sold the last three consensus-level raises (-3.79, -3.28, -2.34) and has outrun a Nikkei down 12% into the print, which leaves a slight negative lean (p_up 46) on a scale of about 4%. The findings sum to -0.2 and the scaled number is -0.32; the two agree in sign and size.
bar: Q2 (Jul-Sep) revenue consensus JPY295.5bn (5 analysts) and FY2027.03 EPS consensus 219.8 (10 analysts) from Yahoo/LSEG earningsTrend (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v10/finance/quoteSummary/6988.T?modules=earningsTrend, read 2026-10-27), against the company's H1 guide of revenue 564.0bn / OP 108.0bn / NP 76.0bn and FY guide of 1,110bn / 200bn / 142bn (EPS 215.75), raised 2026-07-28 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6988&b=k202607280038). The H1 guide implies Q2 revenue 292.3bn and OP 58.8bn. positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-26: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (a real zero, unchanged). 信用倍率 4.54 (kabutan, 2026-10-27), so margin longs are crowded relative to margin shorts. No option skew exists. BlackRock raised its stake from 9.35% to 10.36% (obligation date 2026-10-20, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6988&b=n202610260849). Run-up is +4.83% over 20 days and +0.5% over 5 days, while the Nikkei fell from 70,684 (10/06) to 62,190 (10/26): about 14 points of relative outperformance into the print. findings.finding: The street already expects the forecast raise. FY EPS consensus is 219.8 (10 analysts, up from 211.9 ninety days ago) against a company plan of 215.75 (+1.9%), and Nitto has raised at every print since 2025-07. FX now offers no H2 cushion (spot 157.7 against a 158 assumption), and the plan still carries about -80億 of remaining Middle-East raw-material impact (-100億 for the year, -20億 used in Q1), so a raise to roughly consensus is the base case and is priced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-27: FY OP raised 170→173bn ('consensus level'), next close -3.79%. 2026-01-26: raised above consensus but on FX and with no buyback, -3.28%. 2025-01-27: raised, -2.34%. 2026-07-28: raised 193→200bn, +2.99%. Upward revisions that only match consensus have been sold three times out of three.
findings.why_not_priced: It IS mostly priced: consensus EPS has already drifted 3.7% above the April level and sits above the plan. If the market were not expecting a raise, the consensus would sit at 215.75 and the stock would not have outperformed a 12% Nikkei drawdown. The residual is the size of the raise against about 145bn of NP consensus, which cannot be known before the release.
findings.independence: Company Q1 presentation (2026-07-28) for the FX assumption and the -100億 Middle-East line: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260727500156.pdf; FX from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X. Consensus from Yahoo earningsTrend. These are three separate sources.

findings.finding: Q2 conditions ran at or above the H1 guide's assumptions. USD/JPY averaged 159.25 over Jul-Sep against the 158 assumption (Q1 sensitivity: +87億 for +13.6 yen, so roughly +8億 in Q2). HDD demand for the CIS circuit boards was strong (Seagate guided its Sep quarter to $4.1bn from $3.6bn). AI-memory process materials and nucleic-acid CDMO were the drivers in Q1. Nitto has beaten its own H1 guide before (FY2023 H1 OP 64.5 against 62.0; Q2 FY2025 about 3bn above the market).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-27: Q2 OP about 3bn above the market, stock -3.79% (the beat did not carry). 2024-10-28: H1 OP +70%, stock +2.98%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Q2 revenue consensus (295.5bn) already sits above the guide-implied 292.3bn. The H1 guide was set on 07-28 with July known, so it sits inside what the company guided. Only the small FX residual and the scale of the HDD/AI ramp are left open. If fully priced, revenue consensus would sit above 300bn.
findings.independence: Seagate guide (Digitimes 2026-07-29): https://digitimes.com/news/a20260729VL202/seagate-demand-revenue-growth-profit.html; FX: Yahoo JPY=X daily series.

findings.finding: Shareholder return: the 500億 / 2.97% buyback (announced 2026-03-30) was completed on 2026-08-24 and the shares were cancelled on 10-20, with no new authorization outstanding. Nitto's recent buybacks came at the Q3 print (2025-01-27) or stand-alone in March (2026-03-30), not at the October H1 prints of 2024 and 2025. The interim dividend stays at 32.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-27: -3.28% on 'upward revision but no buyback, which had been highly expected' (Fisco). 2025-01-28: the buyback announcement 'supported' a -2.34% day. 2026-03-31: the stand-alone buyback announcement firmed the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: The calendar of past buybacks is public, so the absence is mostly expected. What is not priced is the low-probability upside of a new authorization now that the last one is done; that is why the range is wide and skewed positive while the point is slightly negative.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is long. 信用倍率 is 4.54, there is no disclosed short, BlackRock added about 1pt to 10.36%, and the stock is flat-to-up while the Nikkei fell about 12% from 10-06 to 10-26. A merely in-line release meets holders who have sold this name on the last three in-line raises.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 7 of the last 11 prints fell the next session (baseline tape, actual release dates checked on kabutan). The median absolute move is about 3.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is visible, so this is largely the baseline lean (-0.57) restated. It is kept small because a finding that merely agrees with the positioning is not an edge. If shorts were set up for a miss, the register would show sellers building; it shows none.
findings.independence: BlackRock 5% report: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6988&b=n202610260849; Nikkei/6988 closes from Yahoo chart API.

findings.finding: The weak Optronics IT-film line (notebook and tablet optical films, cut sharply in Q1 by customer production adjustments under high memory prices) faces a lighter headwind than in July. TrendForce revised its 2026 notebook shipment decline from -13.6% (07-01) to -9.4% (09-04).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior: Optronics IT weakness was disclosed with a raise in July (+2.99%).
findings.why_not_priced: This is an industry proxy, not a company number, and it is public. It is filed small because the July FY Optronics guide (OP 1,480億, cut by 17億) was set against the worse forecast. Optronics is about half of revenue, and the rest of the company (Industrial Tape +65% OP in Q1) dominates the delta.

baseline_tension: This agrees with the baseline lean (-0.57: margin overhang plus run-up) but adds little to it. The strongest positive the release could carry is a new buyback after the 08-24 completion, or a raise well above the ~145bn NP consensus driven by the HDD/AI-memory ramp. I looked for both: buyback timing history argues against an October authorization, and no company-level number suggests a raise well above consensus.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): three of five draft findings were negative. I wrote out the strongest positive (a buyback, or a raise above consensus) in baseline_tension; I had already looked for both, so the draft's p_up of 44 moved only to 46.
Open question 4 (a run-in as a short signal went wrong once): the positioning finding was cut from -0.7 to -0.4, because it largely restates the baseline lean.
Capital-return finding trimmed from -0.3 to -0.2: the buyback calendar is public, which is rule 1's logic applied to a visible absence.
Rule 1 (月次 misses): not applicable, since Nitto publishes no monthly series; nothing changed on that basis.
